title: 第21章 欧阳克穿越记上第22章 欧阳克穿越记中
content_zh:
事业脑——欧阳克临睡前还好端端在书房里处理着商道的琐事，毕竟白驼山庄在他的运作下，虽说不能算富可敌国，但也是西域第一世家！更何况武力方面有自家叔父在，更是无人敢惹！
想到自家叔父最近清心寡欲的模样，欧阳克就忍不住有些想笑！
为了天下第一，自家叔父疯狂的研究少林武学。但少林武学你必须先看得懂佛经，这也让叔父的性子最近温和了不少！
原来一点错随时随地将人喂蛇，昨天下人犯了错居然只是训斥了两句就过去了。
想到这，欧阳克不免有些忍俊不禁！
不过自家叔父也是可怜人，一心追求天下第一，但偏偏昔日的对手都因各种原因不再出现了，这让练就绝世武功的叔父无用武之地！
昔日天下五绝，东邪因女儿自绝身亡，北丐归隐山林，中神通早已去世，南帝倒是还活着，但也早已出家为僧！只剩下一个西毒！
这也就是因为佛经脾气好了不少，不然叔父绝对要气吐血！感情自己追求的天下第一在其他人眼里一文不值！这让他怎么能不气愤呢！
不过令欧阳克没想到的事，自家叔父对武学的热爱减轻了反而不好！
因为他来迫害自己了！
欧阳克怎么也没想到自己还能有被逼婚的一天！
想他万花丛中过，片叶不沾身，早年更是莺莺燕燕不断，只不过最近沉迷事业略显孤单，结果向来只在乎武功的叔父居然让自己早日成婚，原因就是欧阳家还没有下代传人！甚至还怀疑自己是不是对黄蓉念念不忘！
欧阳克简直无奈，被杨康成功带成事业脑的他真的是一心想让白驼山庄发扬光大啊！绝不是因为黄蓉才不成婚！
叔父说这话也不看看自己满屋子的姬妾，自己会因为黄蓉不成婚吗？那简直是笑话！他分明是嫌麻烦！看到杨康操作的欧阳克其实也很想模仿，但奈何他现在还孩子啊!
被自家叔父反复询问的欧阳克好不容易清静休息一会，但没想到睁眼以后居然来到了一个完全陌生的世界！
感受着腿部的疼痛，再看看周围的景色，欧阳克简直想骂人！但凡他早来一会，巨石绝不会压住他！
上辈子虽然黑玉断续膏治好了他的腿，但终究还是有点后遗症的，阴天下雨他的腿难免有些疼痛，不过比起断腿来说，这简直不算什么了！
没错，现在是杨康接他们叔侄回中原的时候！
不过看着眼前和自己叔父说话的杨康，欧阳克倒是有些恍惚！见惯了杨康智珠在握的样子，眼前的这个人让自己明显感到浮躁和功利！
虽然不知道自己怎么会来，但欧阳克也懒得管，毕竟自己暂时回不去了！等看完原主的记忆以后，欧阳克倒是有些明白了！

他没想到的是，这里和他的世界有些不同！
不过跟随自家叔父研究少林武学多年，他对于佛经自然不陌生。
这应该就是佛家所说的一花一世界，一叶一菩提吧！
不过令他没想到的是，原主居然也不是欧阳克，而是被穆念慈害死之后重新来过的人！
content_en:
Business brain - Ouyang Ke was still in the study dealing with trivial business affairs before going to bed. After all, under his operation, White Camel Villa, although not as rich as the country, was still the number one family in the Western Region! What's more, no one dares to mess with his uncle when it comes to force!
Thinking of his uncle's recent lack of desire, Ouyang Ke couldn't help but want to laugh!
In order to be the best in the world, his uncle studied Shaolin martial arts crazily. But to learn Shaolin martial arts, you must first understand the Buddhist scriptures. This has also made my uncle's temperament become much gentler recently!
It turns out that if you make a mistake, you can feed someone to a snake anytime, anywhere. Yesterday, when the servant made a mistake, he just scolded him and let him go.
Thinking of this, Ouyang Ke couldn't help but laugh!
However, my uncle is also a pitiful man. He pursues the best in the world, but his former opponents no longer appear due to various reasons, which makes his uncle who has practiced peerless martial arts useless!
In the past, among the Five Wonders of the World, Dong Xie died due to his daughter's suicide, Bei Beggar retired to the mountains and forests, Zhong's supernatural powers had long since passed away, and Nan Di was still alive, but he had already become a monk! There is only one Xidu left!
This is because Sutra's temper has improved a lot, otherwise my uncle would definitely vomit blood! Feeling: The number one in the world you pursue is worthless in the eyes of others! How could he not be angry?
But what Ouyang Ke didn't expect was that it would be bad if his uncle's love for martial arts weakened!
Because he came to persecute me!
Ouyang Ke never thought that he would be forced to get married one day!
I thought that he had been surrounded by thousands of flowers, and not a single leaf touched his body. In his early years, he was full of flutters and flutters, but recently he was obsessed with his career and felt a little lonely. As a result, his uncle, who always only cared about martial arts, actually asked him to get married as soon as possible. The reason was that the Ouyang family had no heirs yet! I even doubted whether I could not forget Huang Rong!
Ouyang Ke was helpless. Having been successfully brought into business by Yang Kang, he really wanted to make White Camel Villa prosperous! It’s definitely not because of Huang Rong that she doesn’t get married!
When my uncle said this, he didn't even look at his house full of concubines. Would he not get married because of Huang Rong? That's a joke! He clearly finds it troublesome! Ouyang Ke, who saw Yang Kang's operation, actually wanted to imitate it, but he was still a child now!
After being questioned repeatedly by his uncle, Ouyang Ke finally took a quiet rest for a while, but he didn't expect that when he opened his eyes, he came to a completely unfamiliar world!
Feeling the pain in his legs and looking at the surrounding scenery, Ouyang Ke just wanted to curse! If he had come earlier, the boulder would never have crushed him!
Although the black jade intermittent ointment healed his leg in his previous life, there were still some sequelae after all. On cloudy and rainy days, his leg would inevitably have some pain, but compared to a broken leg, this was nothing!
That's right, now is the time for Yang Kang to take their uncle and nephew back to the Central Plains!
But looking at Yang Kang talking to his uncle in front of him, Ouyang Ke felt a little dazed! I am used to seeing Yang Kang Zhizhu in control, but the person in front of me makes me feel obviously impetuous and utilitarian!
Although he didn't know how he came, Ouyang Ke didn't bother to care. After all, he couldn't go back for the time being! After reading the memory of the original owner, Ouyang Ke finally understood!
What he didn't expect was that this world was a little different from his!
However, he has studied Shaolin martial arts with his uncle for many years, so he is naturally no stranger to Buddhist scriptures.
This should be what the Buddhists say: one flower, one world, one leaf, one bodhi!
But what he didn't expect was that the original owner was not Ouyang Ke, but someone who had come back after being killed by Mu Nianci!
